name: wasteless
description: WasteLess monorepo: Client (React) and Server (Express + MongoDB API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @wasteless/server" "npm run dev -w @wasteless/client"
scripts.build: npm run sync:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run sync:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
